descriptors.name: iroha.connect.ws.ticket
descriptors.description: Build Connect WebSocket join metadata (URL + auth headers/protocol token).

token.description: Explicit token for the selected role.

token_app.description: Token alias used when `role=app` and `token` is omitted.

token_wallet.description: Token alias used when `role=wallet` and `token` is omitted.

node_url.description: Explicit trusted node URL. Torii never derives a credential-bearing destination from request forwarding headers.

input_schema.description: Provide the canonical `sid`, selected `role`, and an explicit trusted node URL.

descriptors.name: iroha.connect.session.create
descriptors.description: Create an Iroha Connect session and return app/wallet tokens.

app_pk.description: Canonical unpadded base64url X25519 application public key (32 bytes).

nonce.description: Canonical unpadded base64url fresh session nonce (16 bytes).

node.description: Optional exact node hint included in both Connect deep links.

descriptors.name: iroha.connect.session.delete
descriptors.description: Delete/purge an Iroha Connect session by SID using the management token or an Authorization header.

token_management.description: Management bearer token returned by `iroha.connect.session.create`; the dispatcher maps this to `Authorization: Bearer ...`.

descriptors.name: iroha.node.query_projection_shard_catalog
descriptors.description: Enumerate the live query projection shard catalog for one resource family (`/v1/node/query/projection/catalog/{resource}`).

asset_definition_id.description: Optional canonical or alias asset-definition selector used to narrow `asset_holders` entries.

offset.description: Stable entry offset within the canonical ordered catalog.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

descriptors.name: iroha.runtime.upgrades.cancel
descriptors.description: Cancel a runtime upgrade by canonical `path.id` (`/v1/runtime/upgrades/cancel/{id}`).

body.description: Optional cancellation payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields (except path/headers/accept) are forwarded.

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.code.get
descriptors.description: Fetch contract code metadata by canonical `path.code_hash`.

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.code.bytes.get
descriptors.description: Fetch contract code bytes by canonical `path.code_hash` (`/v1/contracts/code-bytes/{code_hash}`).

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.call_and_wait
descriptors.description: Call a deployed contract instance and poll exact global pipeline status until state-resolved Applied; state-resolved Rejected and Expired fail. Status polling decodes only exact HTTP 200 payloads, treats only HTTP 404 as pending, and rejects every other HTTP status. The Applied result has exactly status, hash, terminal_kind, attempts, elapsed_ms, optional submit, and final.

body.description: Exact contract-call request payload. Wait controls are never forwarded into this body.

hash.description: Optional exact canonical Iroha transaction hash override.

status_accept.description: Optional Accept header for status polling calls (defaults to application/json).

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.state.get

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.list
descriptors.description: List accounts with optional query filters/pagination (supports flat top-level query args).

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.get
descriptors.description: Fetch canonical account detail from `path.account_id`. Defaults to JSON; set accept=application/x-norito for typed Norito.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.qr
descriptors.description: Fetch explorer account QR code by canonical `path.account_id`.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.query
descriptors.description: Query accounts with filter/select/sort/pagination envelope (flat shortcuts supported).

body.description: Raw QueryEnvelope payload. If provided, it takes precedence over shortcut fields.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.onboard.plan
descriptors.description: Plan sponsored onboarding without mutating state. Send the dedicated token only as the outer MCP X-Iroha-Onboarding-Token header.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.onboard.prepare
descriptors.description: Revalidate a signed onboarding receipt and return an authenticated exact transaction envelope without submitting it. The onboarding token is accepted only from the outer MCP request.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.onboard.submit
descriptors.description: Submit only the exact authenticated transaction envelope returned by iroha.accounts.onboard.prepare. The onboarding token is accepted only from the outer MCP request.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

descriptors.name: iroha.assets.holders

descriptors.name: iroha.assets.holders.query
descriptors.description: Query asset holders for canonical `path.definition_id` with the QueryEnvelope input. Supports exact aggregate DSL queries, for example PAYNET PKR alias users grouped by `primary_alias_domain` with `distinct_count(account_id)` and `sum(quantity)`. Production aggregate reads serve local DA projection shards as `query_source=projection_da_cache` and hydrate missing shards from approved SoraFS providers as `query_source=projection_da_hydrated`; incomplete projections return `projection_archive_unavailable` instead of scanning live holders. `live_debug` requires an explicit debug opt-in.

body.description: Raw QueryEnvelope payload. If provided, it takes precedence over shortcut fields.

descriptors.name: iroha.transactions.wait
descriptors.description: Poll exact global pipeline status for an existing transaction hash until state-resolved Applied; state-resolved Rejected and Expired fail. Status polling decodes only exact HTTP 200 payloads, treats only HTTP 404 as pending, and rejects every other HTTP status. The Applied result has exactly status, hash, terminal_kind, attempts, elapsed_ms, and final.

status_accept.description: Optional Accept header for status polling calls (defaults to application/json).

descriptors.name: iroha.transactions.status
descriptors.description: Get the latest typed pipeline status for canonical `query.hash`. Defaults to JSON; set accept=application/x-norito for typed Norito.
